titles.romaji: Mirai Shounen Conan: Tokubetsu-hen - Kyodaiki Gigant no Fukkatsu
titles.native: 未来少年コナン特別篇　巨大機ギガントの復活

description: Mirai Shounen Conan: Kyodaiki Gigant no Fukkatsu is an edited version of the television series' last three episodes. The movie was released alongside Kaze no Tani no Nausicaä.
